body.title: Add the insrc_present MCP tool
body.summary: Add the insrc_present input shape to the schema registry, a workflow.pending wrapper in daemon-stream.ts, a handler that resolves the repo as insrc_workflow_approve does and answers presented and notPending against the pending list (a record with no document file is not presentable; ids matched without regard to the case of the story part; one to twenty names), register the tool in server.ts, and update the pins: the golden tool-surface fixture (inserted in name-sorted position, count thirteen, the 'twelve tools' title and length check in forward-step.test.ts), EXPECTED_TOOLS and PHASELESS_TOOLS in schema-registry.test.ts, and the steering tool-catalog row in steering-block.md (the only steering edit in this task; the prose is t7).
acceptanceChecks: insrc_present answers presented and notPending for pending and non-pending names and rejects an empty, oversized or non-string list
With no resolvable repo the tool answers an error and presents nothing
The golden fixture, forward-step test and schema registry tests pass with thirteen tools

tests.name: insrc_present answers presented and notPending against the daemon's pending list and rejects an empty or oversized list
the schema registry's expected tool list and the steering skeleton's tool catalog name insrc_present
the MCP tool surface golden fixture lists insrc_present and the tool count is thirteen
insrc_present with a resolver that finds no repo answers an error and presents nothing
a pending record with no document file is reported as not pending by the tool and by the chat
